task: P.C2 stage 2: reach conditioning at an EQUAL effective sample (128 accepted worlds), validated against the live W128 bid

approval.caps_set_by: implementer, stated to the owner before the run

process_library: R0-parity 221fe041 (bitwise == B0 on the A03 probe set)

population.source: natural v3 deals by best_agents(worlds=128) at all seats, fresh agents per deal, played through showing only
population.focal_positions: every blind bid actually reached with k >= 1 earlier bidders and >= 2 legal bids

arms.live: the live W128 agent's actual bid (current F reconstruction, its own RNG)
arms.F128c: noise control: argmax on 128 fresh unconditioned sampler worlds (stream test|c2-s2|F|<source>|<k>)
arms.R128: argmax on the first 128 sampler worlds whose clone predecessors all pass (stream test|c2-s2|R|<source>|<k>), sampler's shown cards
arms.RC128: same 128 accepted worlds with the predecessors' actually chosen NOLO cards

rejection.shortfall: recorded; the accepted worlds are used

validation.law: RC model: fresh sampler worlds accepted by the clone pass check, with chosen cards (stream validation|c2-s2|<source>|<k>)
validation.rule: only where an arm's pick differs from the live bid (identical picks differ by exactly 0)
validation.endpoint: paired value difference, arm pick minus live pick, per reached call; per-deal sum; candidate minus F128c control

caps.rule: total including any pre-flight; stop before a deal if spent + mean deal cost would exceed a cap

not_claimed: the validation law is a clone-predecessor model, not the real W128 bidders' posterior; no whole-game strength claim
